# Volcano Plots {.divider}

<!-- slide 24.1 -->
## What is a Volcano Plot? {.smaller}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Effect size meets significance

**Purpose:** Visualize differential expression results — identify statistically significant and biologically meaningful changes at a glance.

**Axes:**

- **X-axis:** log₂(Fold Change) — magnitude of change
- **Y-axis:** −log₁₀(p-value) — statistical significance

**Quadrants:** Top-right → up-regulated, significant ; Top-left → down-regulated, significant ; Bottom → not significant

**Thresholds (typical):** |log₂FC| > 1 (2-fold change) ; p-value < 0.05 → −log₁₀(p) > 1.3

<!-- slide 24.2 -->
## What is a Volcano Plot? — Result {.plot-slide background-color="#f6f4ee"}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Volcano at a glance

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5.5

np.random.seed(42)
n = 2000
log2fc = np.random.normal(0, 1.5, n)
pvals  = np.random.exponential(0.4, n).clip(1e-30, 1)
# add some truly significant genes
sig_idx = np.random.choice(n, 80, replace=False)
log2fc[sig_idx[:40]] += 3
log2fc[sig_idx[40:]] -= 3
pvals[sig_idx] *= 1e-6

neg_log_p = -np.log10(pvals)
colors = np.where((log2fc >  1) & (neg_log_p > 1.3), RED,
         np.where((log2fc < -1) & (neg_log_p > 1.3), GREEN, GREY))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 5.5))
ax.scatter(log2fc, neg_log_p, c=colors, s=12, alpha=0.7, linewidths=0)
ax.axhline(1.3, color=INK, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--')
ax.axvline( 1,  color=INK, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--')
ax.axvline(-1,  color=INK, linewidth=0.8, linestyle='--')
ax.set_xlabel('log₂(Fold Change)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('−log₁₀(p-value)',   fontsize=11)
ax.set_title('Volcano Plot', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
up   = ((log2fc >  1) & (neg_log_p > 1.3)).sum()
down = ((log2fc < -1) & (neg_log_p > 1.3)).sum()
ax.text( 4, neg_log_p.max()*0.92, f'↑ {up}',  color=RED,   fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(-6, neg_log_p.max()*0.92, f'↓ {down}', color=GREEN, fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

<!-- slide 26 -->
## Volcano Plot: Data Preparation {.smaller .scrollable}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Build the DE table

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "1-10|12-18|20-27"

# Step 1: Generate differential expression results
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

np.random.seed(42)
n_genes = 2000

de_results = pd.DataFrame({
    'gene'    : [f'gene_{i:04d}' for i in range(n_genes)],
    'log2FC'  : np.random.normal(0, 1.5, n_genes),
    'pvalue'  : np.random.exponential(0.4, n_genes).clip(1e-30, 1),
})

# Step 2: Compute derived columns
de_results['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(de_results['pvalue'])
de_results['regulation']  = 'ns'   # not significant

up   = (de_results['log2FC'] >  1) & (de_results['neg_log10_p'] > 1.3)
down = (de_results['log2FC'] < -1) & (de_results['neg_log10_p'] > 1.3)
de_results.loc[up,   'regulation'] = 'up'
de_results.loc[down, 'regulation'] = 'down'

# Step 3: Inspect
print(de_results['regulation'].value_counts())
# up       38
# down     41
# ns     1921
```

<!-- slide 27 -->
## Volcano Plot: Building the Figure {.smaller .scrollable}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Volcano plot in matplotlib

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "1-5|7-17|19-30"

# Color map for regulation status
color_map = {'up': COLORS['primary'], 'down': COLORS['primary'], 'ns': COLORS['text_light']}
size_map  = {'up': 30,        'down': 30,        'ns': 12}
alpha_map = {'up': 0.85,      'down': 0.85,      'ns': 0.4}

# Build figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 6))

for status, group in de_results.groupby('regulation'):
    ax.scatter(group['log2FC'], group['neg_log10_p'],
               c=color_map[status], s=size_map[status],
               alpha=alpha_map[status], label=status,
               linewidths=0, zorder=3 if status != 'ns' else 1)

# Threshold lines
ax.axhline(1.3, color='black', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax.axvline( 1,  color='black', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)
ax.axvline(-1,  color='black', linewidth=0.9, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6)

# Labels & style
ax.set_xlabel('log₂(Fold Change)', fontsize=12, labelpad=8)
ax.set_ylabel('−log₁₀(p-value)',   fontsize=12, labelpad=8)
ax.set_title('Differential Gene Expression', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax.legend(title='Regulation', frameon=False)
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

<!-- slide 28 -->
## Volcano Plot: Labelling Top Genes {.smaller .scrollable}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Annotate the most significant hits

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.5

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from adjustText import adjust_text   # pip install adjustText

np.random.seed(42)
n = 2000
df = pd.DataFrame({
    'gene'    : [f'gene_{i:04d}' for i in range(n)],
    'log2FC'  : np.random.normal(0, 1.5, n),
    'pvalue'  : np.random.exponential(0.4, n).clip(1e-30, 1),
})
# spike in significant genes
sig = np.random.choice(n, 80, replace=False)
df.loc[sig[:40], 'log2FC'] += 3;  df.loc[sig[40:], 'log2FC'] -= 3
df.loc[sig, 'pvalue'] *= 1e-6
df['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(df['pvalue'])
df['reg'] = np.where((df['log2FC']> 1)&(df['neg_log10_p']>1.3),'up',
            np.where((df['log2FC']<-1)&(df['neg_log10_p']>1.3),'down','ns'))

cm = {'up':RED,'down':GREEN,'ns':GREY}
sm = {'up':35,'down':35,'ns':10}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 5.5))
for st, grp in df.groupby('reg'):
    ax.scatter(grp['log2FC'], grp['neg_log10_p'],
               c=cm[st], s=sm[st], alpha=0.75 if st!='ns' else 0.35,
               linewidths=0, zorder=3 if st!='ns' else 1)
ax.axhline(1.3,color='black',lw=0.9,ls='--',alpha=0.6)
ax.axvline(1,  color='black',lw=0.9,ls='--',alpha=0.6)
ax.axvline(-1, color='black',lw=0.9,ls='--',alpha=0.6)

top = df.nlargest(8,'neg_log10_p')
texts = [ax.text(r['log2FC'], r['neg_log10_p'], r['gene'],
                 fontsize=7, fontweight='bold') for _, r in top.iterrows()]
try:
    adjust_text(texts, ax=ax, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=GREY, lw=0.7))
except Exception:
    pass

ax.set_xlabel('log₂(Fold Change)'); ax.set_ylabel('−log₁₀(p-value)')
ax.set_title('Volcano Plot with Top-Gene Labels', fontweight='bold')
ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```

::: {.takeaway}
[The bottom line]{.tl}
Color encodes **direction** — red up, green down — and grey is everything that didn't clear the thresholds.
:::

## Exercise: Volcano Plot {.smaller .scrollable}

[Differential expression]{.eyebrow}

### Hands-on practice

::: {.exercise}
**Coding Exercise — Volcano Plot**

Build a publication-quality volcano plot from a 3 000-gene RNA-seq dataset: classify regulation, size points by baseMean, and label the 10 most significant genes.

::: {.sandbox}
```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

from genomics_course.data import load_deseq2

# Real DESeq2 output: columns = gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, pvalue, padj
de_data = load_deseq2(contrast='drought')

# Your tasks:
# 1. Compute neg_log10_p from `pvalue` and classify regulation (up / down / ns)
#    using log2FoldChange and padj
# 2. Create a volcano plot, colored by regulation status
# 3. Size points by baseMean (log-scaled)
# 4. Add threshold lines at |log2FoldChange| = 1.5 and padj = 0.01
# 5. Label the top 10 most significant genes

# Bonus: Create an interactive version with plotly.express.scatter()
```
:::

<details>
<summary>Show solution</summary>

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true

import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from adjustText import adjust_text
from genomics_course.data import load_deseq2

de_data = load_deseq2(contrast='drought').copy()
# unify a working pvalue column (some rows can have NA padj)
de_data['pvalue']     = de_data['pvalue'].fillna(1.0)
de_data['neg_log10_p'] = -np.log10(de_data['pvalue'].clip(lower=1e-300))
de_data['regulation']  = 'ns'
de_data.loc[(de_data.log2FoldChange >  1.5) & (de_data.pvalue < 0.01), 'regulation'] = 'up'
de_data.loc[(de_data.log2FoldChange < -1.5) & (de_data.pvalue < 0.01), 'regulation'] = 'down'

PAL = {'up': COLORS['primary'], 'down': COLORS['secondary'], 'ns': COLORS['text_light']}
SIZE = np.log1p(de_data['baseMean']) * 2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6),
                       facecolor="white")
ax.set_facecolor("white")

for reg, grp in de_data.groupby('regulation'):
    ax.scatter(grp.log2FoldChange, grp.neg_log10_p,
               c=PAL[reg], s=SIZE[grp.index],
               alpha=0.5, linewidths=0, label=reg)

ax.axhline(-np.log10(0.01), ls='--', color=COLORS['zero_line'], lw=1)
ax.axvline(-1.5, ls='--', color=COLORS['zero_line'], lw=1)
ax.axvline( 1.5, ls='--', color=COLORS['zero_line'], lw=1)

top10 = de_data[de_data.regulation != 'ns'].nsmallest(10, 'pvalue')
texts = [ax.text(r.log2FoldChange, r.neg_log10_p, r.gene,
                 fontsize=8, color=COLORS['text_dark']) for _, r in top10.iterrows()]
adjust_text(texts, ax=ax, arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color=COLORS['text_light'], lw=0.6))

ax.set_title('VOLCANO PLOT — DIFFERENTIAL EXPRESSION', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)
ax.set_xlabel('log₂ Fold Change')
ax.set_ylabel('−log₁₀(p-value)')
ax.legend(frameon=False, title='regulation')
ax.text(0.01, -0.12, 'Point size ∝ baseMean (log-scaled). Thresholds: |log₂FC| = 1.5, p = 0.01.',
        transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=8.5, style='italic', color=COLORS['text_light'])
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

</details>
